name: Blender
what_it_is: An open-source 3D computer graphics software toolset.
mentions: Used in conjunction with Claude to automate the generation of 3D models.

name: Claude
what_it_is: An AI assistant and LLM family developed by Anthropic.
mentions: Used to generate 3D models with Blender and automatically import them into Roblox.

name: Devmaxx
what_it_is: A mobile learning application designed for daily system design practice and interview preparation.
mentions: Pitched by the creator as a tool to learn and practice system design concepts every day.

name: Roblox Open Cloud API
what_it_is: A set of REST APIs allowing external services to interact with Roblox resources and assets.
mentions: Enables Claude to programmatically upload and configure assets within a Roblox game.
